{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Side dishes|Side dishes]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|US Cuisine]]

This is a classic [[Cookbook:New England cuisine|New England]] potato salad. Chopping the potatoes into small pieces allows more surface to be coated and improves the flavor.

== Ingredients ==

*3 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] [[Cookbook:California cuisine|California]] long white [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]] 
*3 [[Cookbook:Hard Cooked Eggs|hard boiled eggs]], [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]]
*1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
*¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]]
*¼ cup sweet pickle juice (from jar of [[Cookbook:Pickle|pickles]]) 
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] dried [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Celery Seed|celery seed]]
*¾ tablespoon [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]
*[[Cookbook:Paprika|Paprika]]

== Procedure ==

#Cut unpeeled potatoes in half and cook until they are tender when tested with a knife. Do not overcook. 
#Peel the potatoes by scraping them lightly with a knife and cut them into ½ inch (1.25 cm) cubes.
#Place potatoes in a large bowl and let them come to room temperature. 
#In a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise, pickle juice and sugar and stir until smooth. 
#Add the mayonnaise mixture, minced onion, parsley, celery seed and chopped eggs to the potatoes. 
#Add salt and pepper to taste. Stir lightly to combine. 
#Place in large serving bowl and sprinkle with paprika. 
#Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.
